title: Nomination board role in corporation counsel selection
summary: A three-member investigative group, including the chair, is looking into the corporation counsel matter, and its report to the full board is tentatively set for the August 12 or August 26 meeting. One member was recused from the corporation counsel selection on attorney advice. The corporation counsel group is ready, but the prosecuting attorney group is not.

timeline.text: The corporation counsel group is ready; the prosecuting attorney group is not.
The investigative groups will meet on their own and report back at the next meeting.
Recusal of a member from the corporation counsel process: After the closed session, the chair said one member was recused from the corporation counsel selection on attorney advice.
That group's report to the full board is tentatively set for the August 12 or August 26 meeting.
Three members, including the chair, serve on the corporation counsel investigative group (a small fact-finding team).
